english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to trailer registration plates; in relation to vehicle registration plates, see offence wording document H19564.
(ii) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(iii) 'Registered' means registered in accordance with the provisions of Part 2 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001 in a register established and maintained by the Secretary of State.
(iv) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.
(v) See also section 44(2)(d) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 for a similar offence which carries a heavier penalty.
(vi) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
